title: Render a Crossplane Composition locally
description: Run `crossplane render` against the package's working tree, so a Composition can be checked without publishing it or standing up a cluster.

example.description: Example XR to render. A bare name resolves inside the module's xrd/examples dir; a path is used as given. Defaults to examples/<project>.yaml.

xrdDir.description: Module xrd/ directory holding functions.yaml and examples/. Defaults to the sibling `xrd` dir of the package.

functions.description: Functions manifest to render with. Defaults to <xrdDir>/functions.yaml.

image.description: function-kcl image to serve the working tree with. Defaults to the pinned `function-kcl` package in the functions manifest.

port.description: Host port the function listens on for the Development runtime.

containerName.description: Name of the reusable function container.

keepContainer.description: Leave the function container running so later renders reuse it. Disable to remove it when the render finishes.

fullXr.description: Print the full XR spec and metadata (crossplane render --include-full-xr).
